title: NYC LL144 as permitted: auditor drops groups under 2%

authority.name: NYC DCWP rules, 6 RCNY 5-300 to 5-304
authority.process: Encodes options the rule leaves to the auditor; LL144 itself sets no pass mark. The four-fifths reading is how audits are conventionally read.

rationale.small_category_exclusion: Permitted: an auditor 'may exclude a category that represents less than 2% of the data' (5-301(d)).
rationale.reading: Audits publish bare ratios with no interval, so readers compare the point value to 0.80.
rationale.accept_test_data: Permitted when historical data is insufficient (5-302).
